description: Defines the NextcloudAPI interface for interacting with Nextcloud notes, including methods for CRUD operations and capabilities retrieval, along with extension functions for specific API calls.

classes.name: NextcloudAPI
classes.description: Interface defining API endpoints for Nextcloud notes operations, including get, create, update, delete, and capabilities retrieval.

methods.name: getNotesAPI
methods.description: Suspended function to retrieve a list of notes from Nextcloud.

methods.name: getNoteAPI
methods.description: Suspended function to retrieve a single note by URL.

methods.name: createNoteAPI
methods.description: Suspended function to create a new note.

methods.name: updateNoteAPI
methods.description: Suspended function to update an existing note.

methods.name: deleteNoteAPI
methods.description: Suspended function to delete a note by URL.

methods.name: getAllCapabilitiesAPI
methods.description: Suspended function to retrieve capabilities from Nextcloud.

methods.name: getNotesCapabilities
methods.description: Extension function to fetch notes capabilities from Nextcloud server.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Extension function to delete a note by ID.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Extension function to update a note with ETag.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Extension function to create a new note.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Extension function to retrieve a specific note by ID.

methods.name: getNotes
methods.description: Extension function to retrieve all notes.
